purpose: Use real search and referral evidence to choose useful game/article work, without authority or opportunity scores.

sources.source: Search Console API, final Google Images query-only
Search Console API, final Web query/page
Existing GA4 Data API acquisition snapshot

decision: Expose referral-medium sources once per host and inspect their linked arrival routes first. Map actual Web queries to pages before proposing copy. Preserve Number Route and other already-corrected explanations until comparable post-change data exist.
runnerUp: Number Route has the strongest exact game intent in this sample: number route game has 61 impressions/0 clicks at the game, and 20/0 at the guide. The period precedes PR262's play-link correction; a second rewrite is not justified yet.

measurement.keepQualification: PR263 changed consented article_game_click coverage. Query clicks, GA4 sessions and individual people cannot be joined or given mixed-period conversion rates.

limits: Images and Web counts remain separate; overlapping windows are not added.
Historical average position is not a current rank. US/global search volume and difficulty are unknown.
Image rows have 1–2 impressions each; do not call them strong demand or force new articles.
Referral-medium source labels are not channel-group classification, individual backlink attribution or evidence of registration/revenue.
No XP, scoring, player data, analytics tracking, permissions or content versions changed.
